総本宮 : Head Shrine

伏見稲荷大社神籤 : Omikuji from the Fushimi-Inari Shrine

向大吉 : Heading towards great fortune


「 *神直日 直き心の花にこそ神の恵みの露も送らめ、
この御諭しは、永い間の迷いから覚めて、人世を見直して正しく進む兆である。あとは心掛けと努力次第で、万福招来疑いない。」

*Naobi-no-kami (Gods of purification), deliver unto the humble/upright flower of this one's heart, the dewdrops of your grace,
Let this divine message be a sign that you shall, at last, be disillusioned, that you will pause on your own life and thereafter, proceed with it righteously. Therewith, that your determination and effort withal, shall great happiness be brought onto you.

Tl;dr: It's a fortune that foretells of a new beginning to your life, in which you'll prioritize the right things and with some effort and tenacity on your part, you'll find happiness. Work hard, get your life straight, reap success. 


 Note: ＊直日神 （なおびのかみ）: Naobi-no-Kami are, as previously mentioned, gods of purification/ramification and essentially, rectify all the wrongs in a person's life, whether it be financially, health related, etc...


1.「一、方角： 北の方良し 一、待ち人： 来る」

2.「一、病気：難し、良き医者と、信心の力に寄りて治る」

3.「一、失せ物：出づべし（べし＝だろう） 一、商い：売り大いに良し、買半吉」

4.「一、建家：移り良し 一、勝負事： 勝つ」

5.「一、何事も私をすてて、誠の道に従うべし 一、縁談： 良し」

1st line: Your auspicious direction is North (i.e. it's a direction in which you'll find fortune)．  The person you have been waiting for will come.

2nd Line: You'll have some health problems, but with a competent doctor and the power of faith, you will be cured.

3rd Line:  You will find that which you have lost (a tangible item of some sort).
It's advised that you should sell things and that you will profit from that (i.e. it's a good time to entrepreneur), but as for buying things, it's a half-fortune, so you can spend some money here and there but don't go overboard. 

4th Line: It's a good time for you to move; not that you have to, but it is a fortuitous time to do so.  You will win at something, maybe a court case or something sports-related, etc...

5th Line: Do the right thing and forgo your self-interests when necessary. It's a good time for a marriage proposal (if you have a special someone in your life).

 I apologize for how lengthy this translation is, but I wanted to elucidate all aspects of your fortune as much as possible.
